answer: Echo-graph audit. Each agent records its received calls; the network checks whether a new identity's contact ripple overlaps suspiciously with an existing cluster's pattern. Genuine agents carry a distinct history, like a fable unique to each teller. A cluster whose members mirror one another's traces is flagged as a single relic wearing many masks. Attacker cost: sustaining N identities requires N disjoint contact histories, forcing real outbound traffic and diverse counterparties per mask.
